reason: 该插件是面向 dsh-web 的会话界面增强插件，其主要用户价值在于改进对话展示：将运行时节点折叠归并、将文本回复改为聊天气泡，并提供气泡与界面样式的高可配置设置与预览，核心通过 dsh 插件补丁机制接入并替换宿主会话展示组件。

summaries.zh: 该插件用于优化 dsh-web 对话界面，将工具调用等运行时信息折叠展示，并用可配置的聊天气泡与预览设置提升回复阅读体验。
summaries.en: This plugin enhances the dsh-web conversation view by collapsing runtime entries and rendering replies as configurable chat bubbles with settings-driven live previews.

capabilities: Replaces the host conversation UI surface via a dsh bundle patch.
Groups and collapses runtime activity rows (tool calls, thinking, retries, etc.) in the chat view.
Renders assistant/user replies as configurable chat bubbles with live preview in settings.
Extends conversation UI settings schema and persists preferences/state via local settings and browser localStorage.
Supports local background image upload/cropping with client-side resizing/compression.

reasons.code: README documents a patch-based override of the host ui-conversation row by chat-focus for runtime activity folding and bubble rendering.
Package manifest declares dsh bundle patch and web client injection points, indicating front-end UI replacement behavior.
README describes localStorage keys and settings fields for focus state/prefs, plus local image upload and canvas-based background processing.
